common.loadFailed: Could not load data from the server.

risk.highAdvice: Humidity is very high. Inspect leaves and fruit closely, separate affected parts and follow the agriculture office's advice on prevention.
risk.mediumAdvice: Humidity is on the higher side. Wet leaves raise fungal risk, so water in the morning and at the plant base.
risk.lowAdvice: Low risk for now. Keep checking leaves regularly.

alerts.tankLowDetail: Tank is at {{v}}%. Fill it before irrigating.
alerts.humHighDetail: Humidity {{v}}%. Check leaves for signs of disease.

recs.rainRule: {{n}}% chance of rain tomorrow. Per the rule, tomorrow's irrigation will be skipped.
recs.riskCheck: Air humidity {{v}}%, disease risk {{level}}. Check leaves today.
recs.harvestSoon_one: {{name}}: harvest starts in {{n}} day. Arrange crates and sales.
recs.harvestSoon_other: {{name}}: harvest starts in {{n}} days. Arrange crates and sales.
recs.allOk: All good. Nothing needs doing today.

farm.autoOn: Auto mode on. The system will irrigate by itself below the threshold.
farm.manualOn: Manual mode on. You are in control now.
farm.pumpOn: Pump started. Mode is now manual.
farm.autoModeNote: Auto mode: the system starts the pump below the threshold
farm.manualModeNote: Manual mode: you are in control
farm.watered: Watered. Moisture is up, tank is down.
farm.noWaterClosedValves: No watering — valves are closed. Turn a valve on first.
farm.serverCmdFailed: Could not send the command to the server.
farm.serverSaveFailed: Could not save on the server.
farm.sessionExpired: Session ended — please log in again.

login.pitchTitle: Run your farm from one calm screen.
login.pitch1: Irrigation with safety limits, rain-skip and a daily pump cap.
login.pitch2: Fields, crop advice and a harvest countdown.
login.pitch3: Tasks, stock and a ledger that shows profit per field.
login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Log in to reach the server.
login.subtitleDemo: Turn off demo mode and log in to see server data.
login.description: Sign in with email and password.

overview.heroSub_one: {{tasks}} task left today · {{rain}}% chance of rain tomorrow
overview.heroSub_other: {{tasks}} tasks left today · {{rain}}% chance of rain tomorrow
overview.forecastNote: Sample data. Real forecasts arrive once a weather service is connected.
overview.rainRuleOnSkip: Rain rule on: tomorrow's irrigation will be skipped.
overview.rainRuleOnWait: Rain rule on: irrigation is skipped above a 60% chance.
overview.rainRuleOff: Rain rule is off. Irrigation runs as scheduled.
overview.zoneBarsNote: The black line is the irrigation threshold.
overview.moist24hNote: Sample data. The dashed line is the irrigation threshold.
overview.moist24hChartLabel: Line chart of soil moisture over the last 24 hours for three zones

irrigation.title: Pump & mode
irrigation.thresholdHint: Auto irrigation starts below this moisture
irrigation.durationHint: The pump runs at most this long
irrigation.zonesNote: A closed valve is skipped during auto irrigation.
irrigation.rulesNote: When a condition matches, the system decides on its own.

fields.noFields: No fields yet. Add one with the form below.
fields.name: Field name
fields.harvestNote: Harvest day varies by variety and season. Use your own variety's figure.
fields.scoutNote: Note down pests, disease or anything unusual you spot.
fields.notePlaceholder: e.g. Spots on lower leaves in Zone C

finance.lossNote: In loss so far; selling more produce will turn it around

inventory.title: Fertilizer, pesticide & supplies
inventory.name: Name
inventory.lowNote: Items at or below their minimum appear as alerts on the overview.
inventory.useNote: Enter how much you used — stock goes down. With a cost, the expense is booked to that field.

devices.liveNote: Live server data · updates as soon as new data arrives.
devices.demoNote: Demo data right now. Turn off demo mode to see the real status of the server's devices.
devices.addNote: Any ESP32 or board sending data in this format shows up on the dashboard. Posting over HTTP works today; the MQTT bridge comes later.
devices.empty: No device has sent data yet. Follow the guide below to add one.
devices.serverDown: Cannot reach the server — the diagram shows the last known state.
devices.readingsNote: What the sensor node last reported.
devices.diagramNote: How field readings reach your phone and pump commands travel back. Moving dashes mean the link is alive. Tap a box to open that device.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.note: Tap a problem to open the device.
attention.allOk: All devices are fine — nothing to do right now.

offline.fix: Check power or battery and Wi-Fi, then restart the board.

slow.fix: Signal may be weak — move it closer to the gateway or raise the antenna.

battery.fix: Charge it or clean the solar panel.

signal.fix: Raise the antenna or move it closer to the gateway.

noCurrent.problem: Relay is on but the pump draws no current
noCurrent.fix: Check the pump wiring, fuse and motor.

mismatch.problem: Relay state does not match the pump
mismatch.fix: The command may not have arrived — switch the pump again.

devices.listNote: Pick a device to see its details.

detail.select: Pick a device from the list.
detail.chartLabel: Chart of this node's soil moisture and battery
detail.chartEmpty: No readings from this node in this period.
detail.chartDemo: The chart shows only real server data.
detail.noPerm: Running the pump needs the operator or owner role.

key.title: Device key
key.note: Put this key in the firmware's X-Device-Key header.
key.none: No key — this node posts without one. Create one.
key.confirm: A new key stops the old one immediately — this device's data will not arrive until the firmware has the new key. Continue?
key.rotated: New key created — put it in the firmware.

devices.keyHint: If the device has a key, send it in the X-Device-Key header — copy it from the device details.

analytics.sampleChartNote: This chart is drawn from sample data.
analytics.dashMark: The dashed line is the irrigation threshold.
analytics.zoneChartLabel: Bar chart of current moisture across three zones
analytics.driestInsight: The driest zone right now is {{zone}} ({{v}}%). Check that zone's pipes and sensor placement.
analytics.perPlantInsight: Daily average water per plant is {{n}} liters. This should change with the crop's stage.
analytics.avgMoistureInsight: Average moisture across zones is {{n}}%. This analysis uses sample data; with real sensors it will show your own farm's trends.

settings.demoModeAccount: Demo mode is on. Turn it off to see server data — the login screen will appear.
settings.demoModeNote: Sensor readings change on their own and the irrigation rules run. Turn it off before connecting real devices.
settings.teamNote: Owners can change everything, operators run irrigation and tasks, viewers only read — enforced on the server.
settings.notifNote: SMS and Telegram are sent by the server (when it has a gateway/bot configured); app notifications and WhatsApp aren't wired yet.
settings.ossSourceValue: The GitHub repository this app was built from.
settings.ossSelfHostValue: The goal is to run on a Raspberry Pi or small VPS so the data stays in your hands.
settings.locationNote: Latitude/longitude for the forecast and the rain-skip rule (owner only).
settings.usersNote: Open an account and hand over the password; change roles or reset.
settings.auditNote: Recent pump, money and account actions.
settings.maxDailyNote: Auto mode will not run the pump past this, so a faulty sensor or rule cannot drain the tank. 0 = no limit.
settings.contactNote: Alerts and the weekly summary are sent here. SMS/Telegram must be on under notifications.

analytics.noTelemetry: No telemetry in this window. Send data from a device or simulator and the charts will appear.
analytics.avgMoistureLive: Average moisture across zones is {{n}}%. The charts are drawn from telemetry stored on the server.

harvest.title: Harvest
harvest.note: Record each picking. Liters per kg is the number that shows whether the system is saving water.
harvest.addIncome: Also add the sale to the ledger
harvest.noZone: Link this field to a zone to track its water
harvest.flowMissing: Set the pump flow in Settings, otherwise liters show as 0.
harvest.flowNote: Time how long the pump takes to fill a bucket of known size, then divide. All water figures use this number.

advice.note: A score from season, rotation, water and market price. Read the reasons — the decision is yours.
advice.plantNote: The field's crop changes, its age restarts and the crop's jobs are added with dates.
advice.priceNote: Note crop prices — they feed the advice.

fieldProfit.title: Profit by field
fieldProfit.note: Pick a field when you record an expense or income and it shows up here.

weekly.title: This week
weekly.note: The last 7 days. Every Friday morning it also goes to your phone.
weekly.flowUnknown: Pump ran {{runs}} times — set the pump flow in Settings to see litres

reports.actionsNow: The action plan always shows what is open right now.
reports.howTo: Opens your browser’s print window. Choose “Save as PDF” as the destination (turn on “Background graphics” for the colour bars).
reports.footer: Made with Farm Command. Figures come from the entries you recorded; lessons are rules of thumb, not expert advice.

full.title: Farm report
full.desc: Everything in one document: profit, action points and lessons.

pnl.title: Profit & loss
pnl.desc: Income, costs and profit by category and by field.

actions.title: Action plan
actions.desc: What to do next: tasks, restocking, harvests, alerts.

lessons.title: Lessons learned
lessons.desc: What the numbers and field notes taught, plus your own notes.

act.harvestSoon_one: {{name}}: harvest in {{n}} day — arrange labour and market
act.harvestSoon_other: {{name}}: harvest in {{n}} days — arrange labour and market
act.recheck: Walk {{field}} again — {{kind}} was noted in the last 2 weeks
act.lossField: {{name}} is making a loss of ৳ {{v}} — review its costs
act.noIncome: Costs are recorded but no sales yet — add your sales so profit is correct

pnl.title: Profit & loss
pnl.hint: From the income and expense entries in the period.
pnl.empty: No income or expense entries in this period.

actions.title: Next action points
actions.hint: Most urgent first. Tick them off on paper as you go.

lessons.title: Lessons learned
lessons.hint: Drawn from your entries and field notes — a prompt for your own judgement.
lessons.empty: Not enough records yet. Log expenses, sales and field notes to see lessons here.

notes.title: Your notes
notes.hint: Saved on this device and printed in the report. Left empty, they print as ruled lines.
notes.next: What I will do differently next season

les.marginDetail: That is {{n}}% of sales. Note what kept costs low and repeat it.
les.noSalesDetail: No sales recorded, so the margin cannot be worked out.
les.lossDetail: Costs were higher than sales. Check the biggest cost below and whether harvest sales are all recorded.
les.topCostDetail: ৳ {{v}} went here — the first place to look for savings (bulk buying, a cheaper supplier, less waste).
les.bestFieldDetail: Profit {{v}}. What did you do here that others missed?
les.worstFieldDetail: Profit {{v}}. Compare its costs and yield with the best field.
les.untaggedTitle: Many entries are not linked to a field
les.untaggedDetail: {{n}}% of the money has no field, so profit per field is incomplete. Pick a field when you add an entry.
les.scoutDetail: {{name}} had the most ({{n}}). Plan earlier checks there and note what treatment worked.
les.scoutDetailAny: Plan earlier checks and note what treatment worked.
les.cleanTitle: {{n}} field checks, no pest or disease found
les.cleanDetail: Keep up the regular walks — they catch trouble early.
les.harvestTitle: Harvested {{kg}} kg; cost about ৳ {{cost}} per kg
les.harvestDetail: Average selling price ৳ {{avg}} per kg. If cost is near the price, there is no margin.
les.harvestNoPrice: Add the price when recording harvests to compare it with the cost.

ag.failed: Could not load the data. Try again shortly.
ag.empty: No sensor readings in this period. Check on the devices page that a sensor is connected.

kpi.stressNote: A zone was below the threshold

todo.title: What to do now
todo.note: Advice worked out from the sensor trends.

insight.waterNow: {{zone}} is below the threshold — water now.
insight.fungal: {{n}} hours of fungal-disease weather — check under the leaves and water in the morning so leaves dry by day.
insight.heat: {{n}} hours above 35° — water at dawn or late afternoon, not midday; mulch keeps the soil cool.
insight.offBand: Soil was in the ideal band only {{n}}% of the time — review the irrigation threshold or schedule.
insight.tank: At this rate the tank reaches 30% in ~{{n}} hours — arrange a refill.
insight.thirsty: {{zone}} used the most water ({{n}} L) — check for pipe leaks or sandy soil.
insight.allGood: Every zone is comfortable — nothing extra to do now.

soil.title: Soil moisture and irrigation
soil.note: Bands: red = dry, green = ideal, blue = too wet. Blue shading = the pump ran.
soil.chartLabel: Soil moisture per zone with irrigation times

zone.title: Zone forecast
zone.note: How fast the soil has been drying since the last watering.

climate.title: Weather and crop comfort
climate.note: Above 35° (orange band) most vegetables drop their flowers.

vpd.title: Air dryness (VPD)
vpd.note: How hard the air pulls water from leaves. 0.8–1.2 kPa suits most vegetables.
vpd.chartLabel: VPD chart with disease and stress limits

zone.high: A little dry — water pull rising

water.title: Water use per day
water.note: Pump time × measured flow, by zone.
water.chartLabel: Bar chart of daily water use per zone
water.flowMissing: Pump flow (litres/min) is not set — add it in settings to get litres.
water.none: The pump did not run in this period.

eff.title: Water per kilogram
eff.note: Litres used per kg harvested — lower is better.
eff.chartLabel: Bar chart of water per kg by field

tank.title: Tank water
tank.eta: At this rate it reaches 30% in ~{{n}} hours.
tank.etaDays: At this rate it reaches 30% in ~{{n}} days.

heat.title: When in the day the soil runs dry
heat.note: Each cell: on how many days the soil was near or below the threshold at that hour. Schedule watering ahead of the red and orange hours.
heat.chartLabel: Heatmap of soil moisture by zone and hour
heat.tip: {{n}}% of days near or below · avg {{avg}}%
